title: Spyros Tools

## Does your server need some quality of life features?
Spyro's Tools is a Datapack made for Creative Building Servers and Worlds. It makes teleporting, Warps and using potion effects much easier.
Take a Wooden Axe, look straight down and right click to open the GUI.


# Features:
Warp Points, Player TP, Effects and Attributes and much more

## Warp Points
A simple way to teleport to whereever you want.
You can customize Item, Name and Positon of any Warp. You can also copy warps and place them on any of 7 customizable Pages.
![New and Empty Warp Page and Warp Page with a lot of Warps.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b93efd72abb3822efd8cdfff00f9cc86cc79a3ec.png)

Use tag _st.admin_ to give yourself the permision to edit warps.
```
/tag @s add st.admin
```

## Player TP
A simple way to Teleport to other Players. Shows the Head of other online Players.
You can Teleport to Player, Teleport a Player to you, Spectate a Player or let a Player Spectate you.
![Buttons to teleport yourself to other player or to teleport player to you.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bad96c83fe4b9135809f3a7c240311ef45f764c1.png)

## Effects and Attributes
Toggle Nightvision, Ressistance, Saturation, Conduit Power and Invisibility.
Set your Speed and Jump Boost from 0 to 30.
Change Player Hight from tiny to giant.
![Menu to give yoursel potion effects or change ones scale.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/461624e6440575d561f93e7b75e424498c641634.png)


## Shared Chest
Adds a "Virtual" Chest that everyone can access. Can be used to store and share items.

## Ender Chest
Adds a simple way to access your Ender Chest through the GUI

## TPC (Teleport Cycle)
Teleports you to next Player. Can also be accessed with this command: 
```
function tools:commands/tpc
```
Especially useful when bound to a keyboard key or mouse button using a macro.
(for example using this mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/commandkeys)
Click button multiple times to cycle through all players online.
